prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System is advisory; incident command retains authority; no autonomous dispatch/control. Requires segmentation/time-synchronization/health-checks/audit-logging. Participants: local fire agencies, county emergency management, state wildland fire resources, aviation support units, cooperating public safety partners. North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet; South Lookout Camera Mast produces Camera Cleaning Log. Both supply timestamped/georeferenced/status-bearing observations and smoke-visibility context. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel) supports launch/recovery/charging/shelter; maintenance controller produces threshold-triggered Battery Swap Ticket. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern) produces traceable event records/recommendations/fire-perimeter intelligence. Smoke Classifier Module supplies plume-confidence scores/Ridge Shadow Mask. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle) supplies weather/wind/visibility and rule-triggered Wind Shift Bulletin. Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall) opens threshold-triggered triage; Duty Detection Officer (Orion) reviews evidence/requests pan-tilt-zoom; records decisions/restriction basis. Confirmation requires persistent smoke/thermal plus independent corroboration or authorized recorded human visual judgment; stale/inconsistent/low-confidence evidence stays triaged; dismissals remain searchable without assignment/public notification. Confirmed Ignition State enables suppression planning. Drone Tasking Service may prepare, not release, obstructed-view missions; shall avoid active aviation lanes maintained by Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold). Drone Pilot Operator confirms launch safety. Air Attack Supervisor (Redtail) deconflicts fixed-wing/rotary-wing/uncrewed routes before launch; confirms operating windows; reviews restrictions against Lantern intelligence before asset release. Airspace Restricted State represents accepted authority-approved restrictions; constrained tasking remains conditional. Marigold supplies aviation status; Tanker Base Manager sequences aircraft and coordinates East Retardant Loading Pump/West Retardant Loading Pump readiness before assignment acceptance. East produces Retardant Batch Slip after metering/sealing. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger) bridges terrain-degraded command/air-to-ground/county paths; preserves available speaker identity. Emberhall marks failures impaired; Orion must acknowledge and verify alternate contact before new aviation coordination acceptance. County Emergency Liaison handles dispatch/roads/evacuation/shelters/notifications; sends Drone Corridor Permit after jurisdiction review; constraints must enter Emberhall before pilot briefing. Crewline Mobile Tablet distributes command-released context/maps/updates to

New part:
S096: The Smoke Classifier Module may be temporarily down-weighted by the Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine when observation quality is suspected to be degraded.
S097: The Helitack Crew Leader uses the Crewline Mobile Tablet to acknowledge air-to-ground instructions and report whether crews are inside any planned drop or reconnaissance area.
S098: The Caldera Incident Command Portal displays crew acknowledgements beside aviation tasks so the Air Attack Supervisor can verify that ground resources are clear before authorizing flight activity.
S099: If the Confirmed Ignition State is active and airspace approval is delayed, the system keeps suppression planning visible while preventing premature aircraft dispatch.
S100: Coordination records are retained with timestamps, participant identities, and radio path status so post-incident review can reconstruct both aviation decisions and interagency notifications.
S101: This section defines how the system converts detection observations, aerial imagery, weather updates, and geospatial overlays into a shared fire behavior assessment for operational use.
S102: The assessment begins when visual detections are correlated with incident geometry, terrain, fuel type, and current resource locations in the mapping workspace.
S103: North Lookout Camera Mast captures a time-stamped smoke column bearing and reports the pan, tilt, zoom, and confidence values needed to project the observation onto terrain.
S104: South Lookout Camera Mast supplies a separate bearing track so the mapping workflow can triangulate a probable origin area and bound the uncertainty ellipse.
S105: The Smoke Classifier Module assigns each observation a smoke likelihood, growth trend, and obscuration flag before the result is made available for analyst review.
S106: The Duty Detection Officer uses the spot snippet to compare the automated classification with visible flame, smoke color, and terrain context before accepting the observation into the assessment queue.
S107: Drone imagery is treated as a higher-resolution confirmation layer when weather, airspace, and communications conditions permit flight operations.
S108: The Drone Tasking Service packages approved imaging objectives as map footprints, altitude bands, and revisit intervals so the requested coverage can be compared with the active perimeter model.
S109: The Drone Pilot Operator uses the swap ticket to keep imaging sorties aligned with available aircraft endurance and expected return time.
S110: Frames collected during a sortie are orthorectified against the terrain model and registered to the incident grid before they are used for perimeter adjustment.
S111: The Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine identifies heat signatures, smoke edges, flame fronts, and potential spot fire indicators in the registered imagery.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
